Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before working with Glorifix Media Concept.

Starter websites (1–3 pages) and Business websites (5–7 pages) take 5–7 working days. Premium e-commerce sites (8–12 pages) take 10–14 days. We agree the timeline with you upfront and send updates on WhatsApp throughout.
Yes. For website projects you pay a deposit to begin, then the balance on delivery once you are satisfied with the result.
Every website package includes one year of free web hosting and a free .com.ng or .com domain. We handle the setup so your site goes live without any technical stress. After year one you can renew at an affordable rate.
We research your ideal audience, design the ad creative, write the copy and build a funnel that turns clicks into customers. Plans come with lead guarantees: Basic 15–20, Silver 30–40, Gold 40–50 and Diamond 60–70 leads.
Business names take 3–5 working days, Limited Liability Companies 5–7 working days, and NGOs / Incorporated Trustees 7–14 working days. We handle the documentation, filing and follow-up; you just supply the details.
Yes. Our office is in Gwagwalada, Abuja, but we serve clients in all 36 states and internationally. Everything is delivered digitally via WhatsApp, email and Zoom.
Yes. The Growth package covers 3 platforms and Premium covers 5, across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), LinkedIn and YouTube. That includes content creation, posting, community management and monthly reports.

Who We Are

Driven by Creativity & Results

Glorifix Media Concept is a full-service digital marketing and creative agency based in Gwagwalada, Abuja, Nigeria (RC 1790453). We help businesses reach their full digital potential through sharp strategy and world-class creative work.

Founded by Soje Ezekiel Oluwaseyi, Glorifix has grown from a one-man operation into a creative hub serving startups, SMEs and established enterprises across Nigeria and beyond.

Innovation

Cutting-edge tools that keep your brand ahead of the curve.

Integrity

Excellence

Good enough is never enough. We hold our work to the highest standard.

Client-First

Your success is our success, at every level.
